sanskrit: asmā ū ṣu prabhūtaye varuṇāya marudbhyo 'rcā viduṣṭarebhyaḥ | yo dhītā mānuṣāṇām paśvo gā iva rakṣati nabhantām anyake same ||
english: Sing praise to him for our abundance — to Varuṇa, to the Maruts, to those who know most; who, as the herdsman keeps cattle, guards the thoughts of men. May the others perish all alike.

sanskrit: tam ū ṣu samanā girā pitṝṇāṁ ca manmabhiḥ | nābhākasya praśastibhir yaḥ sindhūnām upodaye saptasvasā sa madhyamo nabhantām anyake same ||
english: Praise him with harmonious song, with the hymns of the Fathers, with the praises of Nābhāka — who at the rising of the rivers stands as middle one with seven sisters. May the others perish all alike.

sanskrit: sa kṣapaḥ pari ṣasvaje ny usro māyayā dadhe sa viśvam pari darśataḥ | tasya venīr anu vratam uṣas tisro avardhayan nabhantām anyake same ||
english: He has embraced the nights; by his māyā he has laid the dawns within; he is visible encompassing all. Three Dawns have grown great following his ordinance, his streams. May the others perish all alike.

sanskrit: yaḥ kakubho nidhārayaḥ pṛthivyām adhi darśataḥ | sa mātā pūrvyam padaṁ tad varuṇasya saptyaṁ sa hi gopā iveryo nabhantām anyake same ||
english: He who sustains the summits, visible above the earth — the primal footstep of Varuṇa is his steed; for he is a shepherd, like a protector of the fold. May the others perish all alike.

sanskrit: yo dhartā bhuvanānāṁ ya usrāṇām apīcyā3 veda nāmāni guhyā | sa kaviḥ kāvyā puru rūpaṁ dyaur iva puṣyati nabhantām anyake same ||
english: He who is the upholder of the worlds, who knows the secret names of the dawn-cows — that seer nourishes manifold forms with his wisdom-songs, as the sky does. May the others perish all alike.

sanskrit: yasmin viśvāni kāvyā cakre nābhir iva śritā | tritaṁ jūtī saparyata vraje gāvo na saṁyuje yuje aśvām̐ ayukṣata nabhantām anyake same ||
english: In him all poetic wisdom is lodged as in a hub; they serve Trita swiftly; as cows meet in the fold, he yoked the horses to the yoke. May the others perish all alike.

sanskrit: ya āsv atka āśaye viśvā jātāny eṣām | pari dhāmāni marmṛśad varuṇasya puro gaye viśve devā anu vrataṁ nabhantām anyake same ||
english: He who in those mantles reposes — all creatures are his; he has touched round about the dwellings of Varuṇa in the heavenly abode; all the gods follow his ordinance. May the others perish all alike.

sanskrit: sa samudro apīcyas turo dyām iva rohati ni yad āsu yajur dadhe | sa māyā arcinā padāstṛṇān nākam āruhan nabhantām anyake same ||
english: He, the hidden ocean, swiftly ascends like the sky; when he laid the sacred formula in those waters; he spread his steps with flaming māyā, ascending the vault of heaven. May the others perish all alike.

sanskrit: yasya śvetā vicakṣaṇā tisro bhūmīr adhikṣitaḥ | trir uttarāṇi papratur varuṇasya dhruvaṁ sadaḥ sa saptānām irajyati nabhantām anyake same ||
english: His white, far-seeing ones have spread over the three earths; the upper realms have been filled thrice; he rules Varuṇa's fixed abode, sovereign over the seven. May the others perish all alike.

sanskrit: yaḥ śvetām̐ adhinirṇijaś cakre kṛṣṇām̐ anu vratā | sa dhāma pūrvyam mame yaḥ skambhena vi rodasī ajo na dyām adhārayan nabhantām anyake same ||
english: He who made the white ones with shining raiment and the dark ones to follow his ordinance; he measured out the primal domain; he who with his prop held apart the two worlds, sustaining the sky like an unborn one. May the others perish all alike.

sanskrit: astabhnād dyām asuro viśvavedā amimīta varimāṇam pṛthivyāḥ | āsīdad viśvā bhuvanāni samrāḍ viśvet tāni varuṇasya vratāni ||
english: The mighty lord, all-knowing, propped up the sky, he measured out the breadth of the earth; he, the universal sovereign, has established all the worlds — all these are the ordinances of Varuṇa.

sanskrit: evā vandasva varuṇam bṛhantaṁ namasyā dhīram amṛtasya gopām | sa naḥ śarma trivarūthaṁ vi yaṁsat pātaṁ no dyāvāpṛthivī upasthe ||
english: Thus praise Varuṇa the lofty; with reverence worship the wise guardian of immortality; may he grant us threefold shelter; may Heaven and Earth protect us in their lap.

sanskrit: imāṁ dhiyaṁ śikṣamāṇasya deva kratuṁ dakṣaṁ varuṇa saṁ śiśādhi | yayāti viśvā duritā tarema sutarmāṇam adhi nāvaṁ ruhema ||
english: O god Varuṇa, sharpen together the resolve and discernment of this suppliant's devotion; by that may we cross over all difficulties and mount a well-constructed ship.

sanskrit: ā vāṁ grāvāṇo aśvinā dhībhir viprā acucyavuḥ | nāsatyā somapītaye nabhantām anyake same ||
english: O Aśvins, the pressing-stones have stirred toward you, the inspired seers with their hymns; O Nāsatyās, come for the drinking of soma. May the others perish all alike.

sanskrit: yathā vām atrir aśvinā gīrbhir vipro ajohavīt | nāsatyā somapītaye nabhantām anyake same ||
english: As Atri the inspired sage called to you both, O Aśvins, with his songs; O Nāsatyās, come for the drinking of soma. May the others perish all alike.

sanskrit: evā vām ahva ūtaye yathāhuvanta medhirāḥ | nāsatyā somapītaye nabhantām anyake same ||
english: Thus I call to you both for aid, even as the wise have called; O Nāsatyās, come for the drinking of soma. May the others perish all alike.

sanskrit: ime viprasya vedhaso 'gner astṛtayajvanaḥ | giraḥ stomāsa īrate ||
english: These songs of praise go forth for the inspired and creative Agni, who is worshipped with unceasing sacrifices.

sanskrit: asmai te pratiharyate jātavedo vicarṣaṇe | agne janāmi suṣṭutim ||
english: For you, O Jātavedas, wide-seeing one, who art delighted in return — O Agni, I fashion the beautiful praise-song.

sanskrit: ārokā iva ghed aha tigmā agne tava tviṣaḥ | dadbhir vanāni bapsati ||
english: Truly, O Agni, your sharp flames are like teeth; with them you devour the forests.

sanskrit: harayo dhūmaketavo vātajūtā upa dyavi | yatante vṛthag agnayaḥ ||
english: The tawny ones with banners of smoke, urged on by the wind toward the sky — the flames of Agni strive in all directions.

sanskrit: ete tye vṛthag agnaya iddhāsaḥ sam adṛkṣata | uṣasām iva ketavaḥ ||
english: These flames of Agni, kindled and striving everywhere, were seen gathered together like the banners of the Dawns.

sanskrit: kṛṣṇā rajāṁsi patsutaḥ prayāṇe jātavedasaḥ | agnir yad rodhati kṣami ||
english: The dark regions tread his path at the advance of Jātavedas, when Agni spreads across the earth.

sanskrit: dhāsiṁ kṛṇvāna oṣadhīr bapsad agnir na vāyati | punar yan taruṇīr api ||
english: Making nourishment, Agni devours the plants yet does not diminish them, going again to the young shoots.

sanskrit: jihvābhir aha nannamad arciṣā jañjaṇābhavan | agnir vaneṣu rocate ||
english: With his tongues he bows down, crackling and blazing with his flame; Agni shines in the forests.

sanskrit: apsv agne sadhiṣ ṭava sauṣadhīr anu rudhyase | garbhe saṁ jāyase punaḥ ||
english: O Agni, your dwelling is in the waters; you pervade the herbs; you are born again in the womb.

sanskrit: ud agne tava tad ghṛtād arcī rocata āhutam | niṁsānaṁ juhvo3 mukhe ||
english: O Agni, that flame of yours blazes upward from the oblation of ghee when it is offered, licking at the mouth of the ladle.

sanskrit: ukṣānnāya vaśānnāya somapṛṣṭhāya vedhase | stomair vidhemāgnaye ||
english: With praises let us serve Agni, who is fed with bulls, fed with cows, whose back is the soma, the creative one.

sanskrit: uta tvā namasā vayaṁ hotar vareṇyakrato | agne samidbhir īmahe ||
english: And we implore you, O Agni, with homage, O Hotṛ, O most excellent in purpose, with kindling-sticks.

sanskrit: uta tvā bhṛguvac chuce manuṣvad agna āhuta | aṅgirasvad dhavāmahe ||
english: And you, O gleaming Agni who receivest offerings, we invoke as Bhṛgu did, as Manu did, as the Aṅgirases did.

sanskrit: tvaṁ hy agne agninā vipro vipreṇa san satā | sakhā sakhyā samidhyase ||
english: For you, O Agni, inspired among the inspired, being true among the true, are kindled as friend by the friend.

sanskrit: sa tvaṁ viprāya dāśuṣe rayiṁ dehi sahasriṇam | agne vīravatīm iṣam ||
english: So you, O Agni, give to the inspired, bountiful worshipper a thousandfold wealth, a vigour accompanied by heroes.

sanskrit: agne bhrātaḥ sahaskṛta rohidaśva śucivrata | imaṁ stomaṁ juṣasva me ||
english: O Agni, brother, mighty one, with bay steeds, of pure ordinances — accept this hymn of mine.

sanskrit: uta tvāgne mama stuto vāśrāya pratiharyate | goṣṭhaṁ gāva ivāśata ||
english: And O Agni, may they who delight in my praise reach you, bellowing in response to the call, like cows to the cow-stall.

sanskrit: tubhyaṁ tā aṅgirastama viśvāḥ sukṣitayaḥ pṛthak | agne kāmāya yemire ||
english: For you, O best of Aṅgirases, all the various fair abodes have been ordered, O Agni, to fulfil your desire.

sanskrit: agniṁ dhībhir manīṣiṇo medhirāso vipaścitaḥ | admasadyāya hinvire ||
english: The wise, the intelligent, the eloquent impel Agni with their thoughts, that he may take his seat at the meal.

sanskrit: taṁ tvām ajmeṣu vājinaṁ tanvānā agne adhvaram | vahniṁ hotāram īḻate ||
english: Him — you, O Agni — powerful in courses, as they spread out the sacrifice, they laud, the carrier and the Hotṛ-priest.

sanskrit: purutrā hi sadṛṅṅ asi viśo viśvā anu prabhuḥ | samatsu tvā havāmahe ||
english: For you are present everywhere, lord over all peoples; we call upon you in the battles.

sanskrit: tam īḻiṣva ya āhuto 'gnir vibhrājate ghṛtaiḥ | imaṁ naḥ śṛṇavad dhavam ||
english: Praise him — Agni who is invoked and blazes with the ghee-oblations; may he hear this our call.

sanskrit: taṁ tvā vayaṁ havāmahe śṛṇvantaṁ jātavedasam | agne ghnantam apa dviṣaḥ ||
english: Him, you — we call upon the listening Jātavedas, O Agni, who smites away our foes.

sanskrit: viśāṁ rājānam adbhutam adhyakṣaṁ dharmaṇām imam | agnim īḻe sa u śravat ||
english: This wondrous king of peoples, overseer of the sacred laws — this Agni I praise; and may he hear.

sanskrit: agniṁ viśvāyuvepasam maryaṁ na vājinaṁ hitam | saptiṁ na vājayāmasi ||
english: Agni the all-invigorating, quivering like a vigorous youth — we speed him like a prize-winning steed.

sanskrit: ghnan mṛdhrāṇy apa dviṣo dahan rakṣāṁsi viśvahā | agne tigmena dīdihi ||
english: O Agni, blazing with your sharp flame, smiting away the foes, burning the rākṣasas at all times.

sanskrit: yaṁ tvā janāsa indhathe manuṣvad aṅgirastama | agne sa bodhi me vacaḥ ||
english: You whom people kindle as Manu did, O best of Aṅgirases — O Agni, that one attend to my words.

sanskrit: yad agne divijā asy apsu jā vā sahaskṛta | taṁ tvā gīrbhir havāmahe ||
english: Whether you, O Agni, art born in the sky or born in the waters, O mighty one — we invoke you with our songs.

sanskrit: tubhyaṁ ghet te janā ime viśvāḥ sukṣitayaḥ pṛthak | dhāsiṁ hinvanty attave ||
english: For you indeed these various peoples with all their fair dwellings impel nourishment for your eating.

sanskrit: te ghed agne svādhyo 'hā viśvā nṛcakṣasaḥ | tarantaḥ syāma durgahā ||
english: May we, O Agni, O thou of good thoughts, beholding men, pass through all days, crossing difficult places.

sanskrit: agnim mandram purupriyaṁ śīram pāvakaśociṣam | hṛdbhir mandrebhir īmahe ||
english: Agni the joyful, beloved of many, swift, with purifying flame — him we implore with joyful hearts.

sanskrit: sa tvam agne vibhāvasuḥ sṛjan sūryo na raśmibhiḥ | śardhan tamāṁsi jighnase ||
english: You, O Agni, luminously wealthy, sending forth rays like the sun, boldly strike down the darkness.

sanskrit: tat te sahasva īmahe dātraṁ yan nopadadyati | tvad agne vāryaṁ vasu ||
english: From you, O powerful Agni, we implore that gift which is inexhaustible; from you comes all desirable wealth.

sanskrit: samidhāgniṁ duvasyata ghṛtair bodhayatāti thim | āsmin havyā juhotana ||
english: Kindle Agni with fuel; with ghee rouse the guest; pour the oblations into him here.

sanskrit: agne stomaṁ juṣasva me vardhasvānena manmanā | prati sūktāni harya naḥ ||
english: O Agni, accept my hymn; grow with this meditation; delight in our sacred verses in return.

sanskrit: agniṁ dūtam puro dadhe havyavāham upa bruve | devām̐ ā sādayād iha ||
english: I place Agni as messenger in front; I invoke the bearer of oblations; may he seat the gods here.

sanskrit: ut te bṛhanto arcayaḥ samidhānasya dīdivaḥ | agne śukrāsa īrate ||
english: O Agni, your lofty, gleaming flames of the kindled, burning one go forth brilliantly.

sanskrit: upa tvā juhvo3 mama ghṛtācīr yantu haryata | agne havyā juṣasva naḥ ||
english: Let my ghee-laden ladle approach you, O beloved; O Agni, accept our oblations.

sanskrit: mandraṁ hotāram ṛtvijam citrabhānum vibhāvasum | agnim īḻe sa u śravat ||
english: The joyful Hotṛ, the sacrificing priest, brilliant of light, luminously wealthy — Agni I praise; and may he hear.

sanskrit: pratnaṁ hotāram īḍyaṁ juṣṭam agniṁ kavikratum | adhvarāṇām abhiśriyam ||
english: The ancient, praiseworthy, beloved Agni, wise in intent, the glory of the sacrifices.

sanskrit: juṣāṇo aṅgirastamemā havyāny ānuṣak | agne yajñaṁ naya ṛtuthā ||
english: O best of Aṅgirases, accepting these oblations one after another, O Agni, lead the sacrifice rightly in due season.

sanskrit: samidhāna u santya śukraśoca ihā vaha | cikitvān daivyaṁ janam ||
english: Being kindled here, O brilliant-flaming, truthful one, bring hither, discerning, the divine company.

sanskrit: vipraṁ hotāram adruhaṁ dhūmaketum vibhāvasum | yajñānāṁ ketum īmahe ||
english: The inspired Hotṛ, unbeguiling, with banner of smoke, luminously wealthy — the banner of sacrifices we implore.

sanskrit: agne ni pāhi nas tvam prati ṣma deva rīṣataḥ | bhindhi dveṣaḥ sahaskṛta ||
english: O Agni, protect us; O god, ward off those who would harm us; shatter enmity, O mighty one.

sanskrit: agniḥ pratnena manmanā śumbhānas tanvaṁ svām | kavir vipreṇa vāvṛdhe ||
english: Agni, adorning his own body with ancient meditation, the seer has increased with the inspired hymn.

sanskrit: ūrjo napātam ā huve 'gnim pāvakaśociṣam | asmin yajñe svadhvare ||
english: I call hither the son of strength, Agni of purifying flame, to this sacrificial rite, this good sacrifice.

sanskrit: sa no mitramaha s tvam agne śukreṇa śociṣā | devair ā satsi barhiṣi ||
english: O Agni, great as Mitra, with your brilliant flame, take your seat on the sacred grass with the gods.

sanskrit: yo agniṁ tanvo3 dame devam martaḥ saparyati | tasmā id dīdayad vasu ||
english: To that mortal who honours Agni, the god, at home in his own body — to him may he shine forth wealth.

sanskrit: agnir mūrdhā divaḥ kakut patiḥ pṛthivyā ayam | apāṁ retāṁsi jinvati ||
english: Agni is the head, the peak of heaven; lord of the earth is he; he quickens the seeds of the waters.

sanskrit: ud agne śucayas tava śukrā bhrājanta īrate ||  tava jyotīṁṣy arcayaḥ ||
english: O Agni, your pure, brilliant flames blaze upward; your lights, your rays go forth.

sanskrit: īśiṣe vāryasya hi dātrasya agne svarpatiḥ | stotā syāṁ tava śarmaṇi ||
english: For you are lord of desirable gifts, O Agni, master of the sun; may I, your praiser, dwell in your shelter.

sanskrit: tvām agne manīṣiṇas tvāṁ hinvanti cittibhiḥ | tvāṁ vardhantu no giraḥ ||
english: You, O Agni, the wise ones impel; they urge you on with their thoughts; may our songs make you grow.

sanskrit: adadbhasya svadhāvato dūtasya rebhataḥ sadā | agneḥ sakhyaṁ vṛṇīmahe ||
english: The friendship of Agni — undeceiving, of inherent power, the messenger, ever praising — this we choose.

sanskrit: agniḥ śucivratatamaḥ śucir vipraḥ śuciḥ kaviḥ | śucī rocata āhutaḥ ||
english: Agni is most pure in his ordinances, pure, inspired, pure, the seer; blazing pure when the oblation is poured.

sanskrit: uta tvā dhītayo mama giro vardhantu viśvahā | agne sakhyasya bodhi naḥ ||
english: And may my devotions, my songs, make you grow at all times, O Agni; be mindful of our friendship.

sanskrit: yad agne syām ahaṁ tvaṁ tvaṁ vā ghā syā aham | syuṣ ṭe satyā ihāśiṣaḥ ||
english: If I were you, O Agni, or if you were I — your prayers here would be fulfilled in truth.

sanskrit: vasur vasupatiḥ hi kam asy agne vibhāvasuḥ | syāma te sumatāv api ||
english: For you are indeed wealth, lord of wealth, O Agni, luminously wealthy; may we abide in your good favour.

sanskrit: agne dhṛtavratāya te samudrāyeva sindhuvaḥ | giro vāśrāsa īrate ||
english: To you, O Agni, of firm ordinances, the bellowing songs go forth as rivers to the sea.

sanskrit: yuvānaṁ viśpatiṁ kaviṁ viśvādam puruvepasam | agniṁ śumbhāmi manmabhiḥ ||
english: Youthful, lord of the clans, the seer, all-devouring, of manifold vibrations — Agni I adorn with my meditations.

sanskrit: yajñānāṁ rathye vayaṁ tigmajambhāya vīḻave | stomair iṣemāgnaye ||
english: We, on the chariot-road of sacrifices, would seek with praises Agni, the firm one with sharp teeth.

sanskrit: ayam agne tve api jaritā bhūtu santya | tasmai pāvaka mṛḻaya ||
english: This singer here, O Agni, truly belongs to you; to him, O purifier, be gracious.

sanskrit: dhīro hy asy admasad vipro na jāgṛviḥ sadā | agne dīdayasi dyavi ||
english: For you are wise, seated at the meal, ever watchful like the inspired sage; O Agni, you shine in the sky.

sanskrit: purāgne duritebhyaḥ purā mṛdhrebhyaḥ kave | pra ṇa āyur vaso tira ||
english: O Agni, O seer, O lord, prolong our life before the troubles come, before the insults come.

sanskrit: ā ghā ye agnim indhate stṛṇanti barhir ānuṣak | yeṣām indro yuvā sakhā ||
english: Those who kindle Agni and spread the sacred grass continually — Indra is their youthful companion.

sanskrit: bṛhann id idhma eṣām bhūri śastam pṛthuḥ svaru | yeṣām indro yuvā sakhā ||
english: Lofty indeed is their fuel, great and far-praised the broad post — those whose youthful companion is Indra.

sanskrit: ayuddha id yudhā vṛtaṁ śūra ājaṭi satvabhiḥ | yeṣām indro yuvā sakhā ||
english: The hero, without fighting, drives back with warriors what is held back in battle — those whose youthful companion is Indra.

sanskrit: ā bundaṁ vṛtrahā dade jātaḥ pṛcchad vi mātaram | ka ugrāḥ ke ha śṛṇvire ||
english: The Vṛtra-slayer took the club at birth; he asked his mother clearly: 'Who are the mighty? Who are those who hear?'

sanskrit: prati tvā śavasī vadan girāv apso na yodhiṣat | yas te śatrutvaṁ ācake ||
english: Speaking back to you with power, like a warrior at a mountain in the waters, he fights — whoever claims enmity against you.

sanskrit: uta tvam maghavañ chṛṇu yas te vaṣṭi vavakṣi tat | yad vīḻayāsi vīḻu tat ||
english: And hear, O Maghavan: what one desires from you, that you have spoken; whatever you make firm, that is firm.

sanskrit: yad ājiṁ yāty ājikṛd indraḥ svaśvayur upa | rathītamo rathīnām ||
english: When Indra the battle-maker, seeking good horses, goes forth to battle — he is the greatest charioteer among charioteers.

sanskrit: vi ṣu viśvā abhiyujo vajrin viṣvag yathā vṛha | bhavā naḥ suśravastama ||
english: Do you, O wielder of the vajra, dispel all attackers in every direction; be our most glorious protector.

sanskrit: asmākaṁ su ratham pura indraḥ kṛṇotu sātaye | na yaṁ dhūrvanti dhūrtayaḥ ||
english: May Indra place our chariot in front for victory, that which the deceivers cannot mislead.

sanskrit: vṛjyāma te pari dviṣo 'raṁ te śakra dāvane | gamemedindra gomataḥ ||
english: May we turn aside your enemies; you are able, O Śakra, to give; may the gift be for us, Indra, rich in cattle.

sanskrit: śanaiś cid yanto adrivo 'śvāvantaḥ śatagvinaḥ | vivakṣaṇā anehasa ||
english: Even when going slowly, O stone-wielder, they that carry horses, troops of a hundred, are eloquent, sinless.

sanskrit: ūrdhvā hi te dive-dive sahasrā sūnṛtā śatā | jaritṛbhyo vimaṁhate ||
english: For day by day thousands and hundreds of joyful words are bestowed upward upon the singers.

sanskrit: vidmā hi tvā dhanañjayam indra dṛḻhā cid ārujaṁ | ādāriṇaṁ yathā gayam ||
english: For we know you, O Indra, winner of wealth, splitting even the firm things asunder, as one who cleaves like Gaya.

sanskrit: kakuhaṁ cit tvā kave mandantu dhṛṣṇav indavaḥ | ā tvā paṇiṁ yad īmahe ||
english: May the Soma drops delight even the eloquent one, O seer, O bold one, when we implore the Paṇi away from you.

sanskrit: yas te revām̐ adāśuriḥ pramamarṣa maghattaye | tasya no veda ā bhara ||
english: He who is ungenerous, who has seized the wealth that belongs to you for his own enjoyment — bring us his wealth.

sanskrit: ima u tvā vi cakṣate sakhāya indra somin aḥ | puṣṭāvanto yathā paśum ||
english: These too perceive you, your Soma-pressing companions, O Indra, as prosperous ones regard cattle.

sanskrit: uta tvābadhhiraṁ vayaṁ śrutkarṇaṁ santam ūtaye | dūrād iha havāmahe ||
english: Even though you seem deaf to us, we call you here from afar for aid, you who have ears that hear.

sanskrit: yac chu śrūyā imaṁ havam durmarṣaṁ cakriyā uta | bhaver āpir no antamaḥ ||
english: If you should hear this call, this hard-to-ignore invocation, and act upon it — be our nearest intimate.

sanskrit: yac cid dhi te api vyathir jagaṇvāṁso amamahi | godā id indra bodhi naḥ ||
english: Even if through confusion we who have come near you have fallen short — be the giver of cattle, O Indra; be mindful of us.

sanskrit: ā tvā rambhaṁ na jivriyo rarabhmā śavasas pate | uśmasi tvā sadhastha ā ||
english: We have seized you as aged men seize a support, O lord of might; we desire you at the meeting-place.

sanskrit: stotram indrāya gāyata purunṛmṇāya satvane | nakir yaṁ vṛṇvate yudhi ||
english: Sing the praise-song to Indra, of many manly deeds, the warrior whom none resist in battle.

sanskrit: abhi tvā vṛṣabhā sute sutaṁ sṛjāmi pītaye | tṛmpā vy aśnuhī madam ||
english: O bull, at the pressing of the pressed Soma, I pour it toward you for drinking; be sated, attain to full exhilaration.

sanskrit: mā tvā mūrā aviṣyavo mopa hasvanā ā dabhan | mākīṁ brahmadviṣo vanaḥ ||
english: Let not foolish, unhostile men deceive you, nor the mockers; win not those who hate the brahman.

sanskrit: iha tvā goparīṇasā mahe mandantu rādhase | saro gauro yathā piba ||
english: Here may the cow-rich ones exhilarate you for great bounty; drink like a wild bull at a pool.

sanskrit: yā vṛtrahā parāvati sanā navā ca cucyuve | tā saṁsatsu pra vocata ||
english: What the Vṛtra-slayer has obtained in the distant realm, ancient and new — proclaim those in the assemblies.

sanskrit: apibat kadruvam sutam indraḥ sahasrabāhve | atrādediṣṭa pauṁsyam ||
english: Indra drank the soma pressed from the water-vessel at the thousand-armed one's place; there he displayed his manly power.

sanskrit: satyaṁ tat turvaśe yadau vidāno ahnavāyyam | vy ānaṭ turvaṇe śami ||
english: That is true: among the Turvaśas and Yadus, knowing the invincible — he spread glory upon the Turvaṇa in calm.

sanskrit: taraṇiṁ vo janānāṁ tradaṁ vājasya gomataḥ | samānam u pra śaṁsiṣam ||
english: The swift one of the peoples, the distributor of vigour rich in cattle — I have proclaimed him as the equal one.

sanskrit: ṛbhukṣaṇaṁ na vartava uktheṣu tugryāvṛdham | indraṁ some sacā sute ||
english: Not to be turned away, like Ṛbhukṣan, in the praises, who increases the Tugryas — Indra when the soma is pressed together.

sanskrit: yaḥ kṛntad id vi yonyaṁ triśokāya girim pṛthum | gobhyo gātuṁ niretave ||
english: He who cleft open the broad mountain for Triśoka, to release passage for the cattle.

sanskrit: yad dadhiṣe manasyasi mandānaḥ pred iyakṣasi | mā tat kar indra mṛḻaya ||
english: What you seize when you are heedless and exhilarated, what you are about to set in motion — do not do that, O Indra; be gracious.

sanskrit: dabhrañ cid dhi tvāvataḥ kṛtaṁ śṛṇve adhi kṣami | jigātv indra te manaḥ ||
english: Even a small deed from one such as you is heard throughout the earth; may your mind come to us, O Indra.

sanskrit: taved u tāḥ sukīrtayo 'sann uta praśastayaḥ | yad indra mṛḻayāsi naḥ ||
english: These fair praises would truly be yours, and your glories — when you, O Indra, art gracious to us.

sanskrit: mā na ekasmin āgasi mā dvayor uta triṣu | vadhīr mā śūra bhūriṣu ||
english: Do not strike us down for a single offence, nor for two, nor for three; do not smite us, O hero, for the many.

sanskrit: bibhayā hi tvāvata ugrād abhiprabhaṅgiṇaḥ | dasmād aham ṛtīṣahaḥ ||
english: For I am afraid of one such as you, the mighty, the overthrower, the wonderful one who bears up in the onslaught.

sanskrit: mā sakhyuḥ śūnam ā vide mā putrasya prabhūvaso | āvṛtvad bhūtu te manaḥ ||
english: Let not the friend find emptiness, nor the son, O abundant lord; may your mind turn back toward us.

sanskrit: ko nu maryā amithitaḥ sakhā sakhāyam abravīt | jahā ko asmad īṣate ||
english: Who then is the companion who, without quarrel, says a true word to his companion? Who now goes away from us?

sanskrit: evāre vṛṣabhā sute 'sinvan bhūry āvayaḥ | śvaghnīva nivatā caran ||
english: In such manner, O bull, at the Soma pressing, going to and fro abundantly, not giving out — like a female gambler going downhill.

sanskrit: ā ta etā vacoyujā harī gṛbhṇe sumadrathā | yad īm brahmabhya id dadaḥ ||
english: I grasp your two bay steeds yoked to your words, of beautiful chariot — when you give it to the brahmin-singers.

sanskrit: bhindhi viśvā apa dviṣaḥ pari bādho jahī mṛdhaḥ | vasu spārhaṁ tad ā bhara ||
english: Shatter all enemies asunder, beat away the harassers, kill the scorners; bring hither that desirable wealth.

sanskrit: yad vīḻāv indra yat sthire yat parśāne parābhṛtam | vasu spārhaṁ tad ā bhara ||
english: What is stored up, O Indra, in the firm one, in the solid, in the rock — bring hither that desirable wealth.

sanskrit: yasya te viśvamānuṣo bhūrer dattasya vedati | vasu spārhaṁ tad ā bhara ||
english: Whose great gift all mankind knows — bring hither that desirable wealth.

sanskrit: tvāvataḥ purūvaso vayam indra praṇetaḥ | smasi sthātar harīṇām ||
english: We belong to you, O Indra, O abundant lord, O leader — to you, the steady master of the bay steeds.

sanskrit: tvāṁ hi satyam adrivo vidma dātāram iṣām | vidma dātāraṁ rayīṇām ||
english: For we know you truly, O stone-wielder, as the giver of refreshments; we know you as the giver of riches.

sanskrit: ā yasya te mahimānaṁ śatamūte śatakrato | gīrbhir gṛṇanti kāravāḥ ||
english: Your greatness, O thou of hundredfold aid, O thou of hundredfold resolve, the singers celebrate with their songs.

sanskrit: sunītho ghā sa martyo yaṁ maruto yam aryamā | mitraḥ pānty adruhaḥ ||
english: Truly well-guided is that mortal whom the Maruts, whom Aryaman, whom blameless Mitra protect.

sanskrit: dadhāno gomad aśvavat suvīryam ādityajūta edhate | sadā rāyā purusprihā ||
english: He who bears abundance of cattle, horses, and manly strength, spurred on by the Ādityas, flourishes always with riches longed for by many.

sanskrit: tam indraṁ dānam īmahe śavasānam abhīrvam | īśānaṁ rāya īmahe ||
english: We implore that Indra for his gift — the powerful, the fearless; we implore the lord of riches.

sanskrit: tasmin hi santy ūtayo viśvā abhīravaḥ sacā | tam ā vahantu saptayaḥ purūvasaṁ madāya harayas sutam ||
english: In him are all aids, fearless together; let the coursers bring him hither, the abundant lord, the bay steeds, for joy at the pressed Soma.

sanskrit: yas te mado vareṇyo ya indra vṛtrahantamaḥ | ya ādadiḥ svar nṛbhir yaḥ pṛtanāsu duṣṭaraḥ ||
english: That exhilaration of yours, O Indra, which is most excellent, most Vṛtra-slaying, whereby you seized the sun with men, which is hardest to withstand in battles —

sanskrit: yo duṣṭaro viśvavāra śrāvāyyo vājeṣu asti tarutā | sa naḥ śaviṣṭha savanā vaso gahi gamema gomati vraje ||
english: He who is invincible, desired by all, worthy of fame, the conqueror in contests — that most powerful one, O lord, come to our pressings; may we reach the cow-rich fold.

sanskrit: gavyo ṣu ṇo yathā purāśvayota rathayā | varivasya mahāmaha ||
english: Even as before, O great and mighty one, be generous to us with cattle, with horses, with chariots.

sanskrit: nahi te śūra rādhaso 'ntaṁ vindāmi satrā | daśasyā no maghavan nū cid adrivo dhiyo vājebhir āvitha ||
english: O hero, I find no limit to your bounty at all; O Maghavan, even now, O stone-wielder, assist our devotions with prizes.

sanskrit: ya ṛṣvaḥ śrāvayatsa khā viśvet sa veda janimā puruṣṭutaḥ | taṁ viśve mānuṣā yugendraṁ havante taviṣaṁ yatasrucaḥ ||
english: He who is lofty, the companion who makes things heard — he, much-praised, knows all births; all peoples in every age call upon Indra the mighty, with ladles extended.

sanskrit: sa no vājeṣu avitā purūvusuḥ puraḥsthātā maghavā vṛtrahā bhuvan ||
english: May he be our protector in contests, the abundant lord, standing before us, the bountiful Vṛtra-slayer.

sanskrit: abhi vo vīram andhaso made ṣu gāya girā mahā vīcetasam | indraṁ nāma śrutyaṁ śākinaṁ vaco yathā ||
english: Sing with a great song, in the joys of soma, the hero of wide perception; Indra by name is famous, the mighty — even as the word.

sanskrit: dadī rekṇas tanve dadir vasu dadir vājeṣu puruhūta vājinam | nūnam atha ||
english: Give wealth for the body, give goods, give the vigorous one in contests, O much-invoked one — give now, and therewith.

sanskrit: viśveṣām irajyantaṁ vasūnāṁ sāsahvāṁsaṁ cid asya varpasaḥ | kṛpayato nūnam aty atha ||
english: Ruling over all goods, even the form of him who has conquered — of the lamenting one — now beyond that.

sanskrit: mahaḥ su vo aram iṣe stavāmahe mīḻhuṣe araṁgamāya jagmaye | yajñebhir gīrbhir viśvamanṣām marutām iyakṣasi gāye tvā namasā girā ||
english: Sufficient for your great desire, we praise the bountiful one, fit to come, fit to arrive; with sacrifices and songs of all people you seek to speed the Maruts — I sing you with a hymn of reverence.

sanskrit: ye pātayante ajmabhir girīṇāṁ snubhir eṣām | yajñam mahiṣvaṇīnāṁ sumnaṁ tuviṣvaṇīnāṁ prādhvare ||
english: Those who cause to fly with their courses along the ridges of the mountains — the sacrifice of the loudly-bellowing ones, the favour of the powerfully-roaring ones, forward at the rite.

sanskrit: prabhaṅgaṁ durmatīnām indra śaviṣṭhā bhara | rayim asmabhyaṁ yujyaṁ codayanmate jyeṣṭhaṁ codayanmate ||
english: Bring the shattering of ill-wills, O most powerful Indra; bring us riches befitting allies, impelling to the mind — the greatest, impelling to the mind.

sanskrit: sanitaḥ susanitar ugra citra cetiṣṭha sūnṛta | prāsahā samrāṭ sahuriṁ sahantam bhujyuṁ vājeṣu pūrvyam ||
english: Gain-winner, great gain-winner, O fierce, brilliant, most discerning, joyful one — the irresistible sovereign, he who conquers the conquerable, Bhujyu, the foremost in contests.

sanskrit: ā sa etu ya īvad āṁ adevaḥ pūrtam ādade | yathā cid vaśo aśvyaḥ pṛthuśravasi kānīte3 'syā vyuṣy ādade ||
english: Let him come hither — the impious one who seized the pious man's filled store — even as Vaśa the horseman took it from him of wide fame, from Kānīta, at the breaking of dawn.

sanskrit: ṣaṣṭiṁ sahasrāśvyasyāyutāsanam uṣṭrānāṁ viṁśatiṁ śatā | daśa śyāvīnāṁ śatā daśa tryaruṣīṇāṁ daśa gavāṁ sahasrā ||
english: Sixty thousand horses, ten thousand as a seat, twenty hundred camels, ten hundred dark mares, ten hundred tawny-striped ones, ten thousand cattle.

sanskrit: daśa śyāvā ṛdhadra yo vītavārāsa āśavaḥ | mathrā nemiṁ ni vāvṛtuḥ ||
english: Ten dark, prosperous, generous-spirited, swift ones — they turned the wheel of the chariot at Mathrā.

sanskrit: dānāsaḥ pṛthuśravasaḥ kānītasya surādhasaḥ | rathaṁ hiraṇyayaṁ dadan maṁhiṣṭhaḥ sūrir abhūd varṣiṣṭham akṛta śravaḥ ||
english: The generous Kānīta of wide fame and rich bounty — giving a golden chariot, he became the most bountiful patron and gained the highest glory.

sanskrit: ā no vāyo mahe tane yāhi makhāya pājase | vayaṁ hi te cakṛmā bhūri dāvane sadyaś cin mahi dāvane ||
english: Come to us, O Vāyu, for our great extension, for vigour and strength; for we have done much for you to give — at once, for great giving.

sanskrit: yo aśvebhir vahate vasta usrās triḥ sapta saptatīnām | ebhiḥ somebhiḥ somasudbhiḥ somapā dānāya śukrapūtapāḥ ||
english: He who with horses carries the dawns three times seven of seventy — with these Soma-pressing Soma drinks, O Soma-drinker, for giving, purified and bright-drinking.

sanskrit: yo ma imaṁ cid u tmanāmandac citraṁ dāvane | araṭve akṣe nahuṣe sukṛtvani sukṛttarāya sukratuḥ ||
english: He who delighted even this one by his own nature in brilliant giving — at the axle of Araṭva, for Nahuṣa, the good-actioned one, to the one of better deeds, the right-purposeful.

sanskrit: ucathye3 vapuṣi yaḥ svarāḷ uta vāyo ghṛtasnāḥ | aśveṣitaṁ rajeṣitaṁ śuneṣitam prājma tad idaṁ nu tat ||
english: He who is self-ruling in the embodiment of praise, O Vāyu, bathed in ghee — urged by horses, urged by splendour, urged by the hunt, that which is swiftly advancing — this is now that.

sanskrit: adha priyam iṣirāya ṣaṣṭiṁ sahasrāsanam | aśvānān na vṛṣṇām ||
english: And then the dear gift for the vigorous one — sixty thousand for a seat, of steeds, of the stallions.

sanskrit: gāvo na yūtham upa yanti vadhrayā upa mā yanti vadhrayaḥ ||
english: Like cattle going to the herd they come to the gelded ones; the gelded ones come to me.

sanskrit: adha yac cārathe gaṇe śatam uṣṭrām̐ acigradat | adha śvitneṣu viṁśatiṁ śatā ||
english: And then in Cārathe's troop he distributed a hundred camels; and also among the white ones twenty hundreds.

sanskrit: śataṁ dāse balbūthe vipras tarukṣa ā dade | te te vāyav ime janā madantīndragopā madanti devagopāḥ ||
english: From the slave Balbūtha the inspired Tarukṣa received a hundred; these people, O Vāyu, rejoice, guarded by Indra they rejoice, guarded by the gods.

sanskrit: adha syā yoṣaṇā mahī pratīcī vaśam aśvyam | adhirukmā vi nīyate ||
english: And that great woman who faces forward — the desire for horses, adorned with gold, is led away.

sanskrit: mahi vo mahatām avo varuṇa mitra dāśuṣe | yam ādityā abhi druho rakṣathā nem aghaṁ naśad anehaso va ūtayaḥ suūtayo va ūtayaḥ ||
english: Great, O Varuṇa, O Mitra, is the protection of you great ones for the worshipper; he whom the Ādityas protect from betrayal — may misfortune not reach him. Sinless are your aids; good aids are your aids.

sanskrit: vidā devā aghānām ādityāso apākṛtim | pakṣā vayo yathopari vy asme śarma yacchatānehaso va ūtayaḥ suūtayo va ūtayaḥ ||
english: O gods, O Ādityas, know the removal of evils; as wings are above a bird, spread shelter over us. Sinless are your aids; good aids are your aids.

sanskrit: vy asme adhi śarma tat pakṣā vayo na yantana | viśvāni viśvavedaso varūthyā manāmahe 'nehaso va ūtayaḥ suūtayo va ūtayaḥ ||
english: Spread that shelter over us, as wings over a bird you extend; all protective things, O all-knowing ones, we meditate upon. Sinless are your aids; good aids are your aids.

sanskrit: yasmā arāsata kṣayaṁ jīvātuṁ ca pracetasaḥ | manor viśvasya ghed ima ādityā rāya īśate 'nehaso va ūtayaḥ suūtayo va ūtayaḥ ||
english: To whom the far-seeing ones have given home and life — these Ādityas rule the riches of all Manu's kin. Sinless are your aids; good aids are your aids.

sanskrit: pari ṇo vṛṇajann aghā durgāṇi rathyo yathā | syāmed indrasya śarmaṇy ādityānām utāvasy anehaso va ūtayaḥ suūtayo va ūtayaḥ ||
english: May evils be warded away from us like a charioteer on difficult roads; may we be in the shelter of Indra and under the protection of the Ādityas. Sinless are your aids; good aids are your aids.

sanskrit: parihvṛted anā jano yuṣmādattasya vāyati | devā adabhram āśa vo yam ādityā ahetanāne haso va ūtayaḥ suūtayo va ūtayaḥ ||
english: One who deviously takes away a man's gift given by you — O gods, the Ādityas have powerfully aimed at him. Sinless are your aids; good aids are your aids.

sanskrit: na taṁ tigmaṁ cana tyajo na drāsad abhi taṁ guru | yasmā u śarma sapratha ādityāso arādhvam anehaso va ūtayaḥ suūtayo va ūtayaḥ ||
english: No sharp missile hits him, no heavy weapon strikes him — to whom the Ādityas of wide shelter have given protection. Sinless are your aids; good aids are your aids.

sanskrit: yuṣme devā api ṣmasi yudhyanta iva varmasū | yūyam maho na enaṣo yūyam arbhād uruṣyatānehaso va ūtayaḥ suūtayo va ūtayaḥ ||
english: We rest on you, O gods, as warriors in armour; you protect us from great sin, you from small. Sinless are your aids; good aids are your aids.

sanskrit: aditir na uruṣyatv aditiḥ śarma yacchatu | mātā mitrasya revato 'ryamṇo varuṇasya cānehaso va ūtayaḥ suūtayo va ūtayaḥ ||
english: Let Aditi protect us widely, let Aditi give shelter — the mother of opulent Mitra, of Aryaman, and of Varuṇa. Sinless are your aids; good aids are your aids.

sanskrit: yad devāḥ śarma śaraṇaṁ yad bhadraṁ yad anāturam | tridhātu yad varūthyaṁ tad asmāsu vi yantanānehaso va ūtayaḥ suūtayo va ūtayaḥ ||
english: Whatever shelter, refuge, good fortune, freedom from disease — whatever triple, protective power — that spread over us. Sinless are your aids; good aids are your aids.

sanskrit: ādityā ava hi khyatādhi kūlād iva spaśaḥ | sutīrtham arvato yathānu no neṣathā sugam anehaso va ūtayaḥ suūtayo va ūtayaḥ ||
english: O Ādityas, look down like spies from a bank; lead us along a good ford as of a horse, along an easy path. Sinless are your aids; good aids are your aids.

sanskrit: neha bhadraṁ rakṣasvine nāvayai nopayā uta | gave ca bhadraṁ dhenave vīrāya ca śrasyate 'nehaso va ūtayaḥ suūtayo va ūtayaḥ ||
english: May welfare be here not for the fierce beast, not for the worn-out cow, not for the yoke-mate — but welfare for the cow and milch-cow, and for the hero who seeks fame. Sinless are your aids; good aids are your aids.

sanskrit: yad āvir yad apīcyaṁ devāso asti duṣkṛtam | trite tad viśvam āptya āre asmad dadhātanānehaso va ūtayaḥ suūtayo va ūtayaḥ ||
english: Whatever evil is manifest, whatever is hidden, O gods — all that place far from us upon Trita Āptya. Sinless are your aids; good aids are your aids.

sanskrit: yac ca goṣu duṣṣvapnyaṁ yac cāsme duhitar divaḥ | tritāya tad vibhāvary āptyāya parā vahānehaso va ūtayaḥ suūtayo va ūtayaḥ ||
english: Whatever ill-dream is among cattle, whatever among us, O daughter of the sky — carry that far away to Trita, to Āptya, O brilliant Dawn. Sinless are your aids; good aids are your aids.

sanskrit: niṣkaṁ vā ghā kṛṇavate srajaṁ vā duhitar divaḥ | trite duṣṣvapnyaṁ sarvam āptye pari dadmasy anehaso va ūtayaḥ suūtayo va ūtayaḥ ||
english: Whether one makes a necklace or a garland, O daughter of the sky — all the ill-dream we hand over to Trita, to Āptya. Sinless are your aids; good aids are your aids.

sanskrit: tad annāya tad apase tam bhāgam upaseduṣe | tritāya ca dvitāya coṣo duṣṣvapnyaṁ vahānehaso va ūtayaḥ suūtayo va ūtayaḥ ||
english: That for the eater, that for the worker, that portion for the one who has approached — O Dawn, carry the ill-dream away to Trita and to Dvita. Sinless are your aids; good aids are your aids.

sanskrit: yathā kalāṁ yathā śaphaṁ yatha ṛṇaṁ saṁnayāmasi | evā duṣṣvapnyaṁ sarvam āptye saṁ nayāmasy anehaso va ūtayaḥ suūtayo va ūtayaḥ ||
english: As we bring together a fragment, a hoof, a debt — so do we bring together all the ill-dream to Āptya. Sinless are your aids; good aids are your aids.

sanskrit: ajaiṣmādyāsanāma cābhūmānāgaso vayam | uṣo yasmād duṣṣvapnyād abhaiṣmāpa tad ucchatv anehaso va ūtayaḥ suūtayo va ūtayaḥ ||
english: We have conquered today; we have prevailed; we have become sinless; O Dawn, from whatever ill-dream we feared — may it shine away. Sinless are your aids; good aids are your aids.

sanskrit: svādor abhakṣi vayasaḥ sumedhāḥ svādhyo varivovitta rasya | viśve yaṁ devā uta martyāso madhu bruvanto abhi saṁcaranti ||
english: The wise one of good thoughts has tasted of the sweet drink's vigour, the drink of wide delight; him, calling honey, all the gods and mortals go about.

sanskrit: antaś ca prāgā aditir bhavāsy avayātā haraṣo daivyasya | inda v indrasya sakhyaṁ juṣāṇaḥ śrauṣṭīva dhuram anu rāya ṛdhyāḥ ||
english: You have entered within and have become Aditi, warding off the wrath of the divine; O Indu, enjoying the friendship of Indra, may you prosper in riches as along the front of the chariot.

sanskrit: apāma somam amṛtā abhūmāganma jyotir avidāma devān | kiṁ nūnam asmān kṛṇavad arātiḥ kim u dhūrtir amṛta martyasya ||
english: We have drunk Soma; we have become immortals; we have arrived at the light; we have found the gods. What now can hostility do to us, and what the malice of a mortal, O immortal one?

sanskrit: śaṁ no bhava hṛda ā pīta indo piteva soma sūnave suśevaḥ | sakheva sakhya uruśaṁsa dhīraḥ pra ṇa āyur jīvase soma tārīḥ ||
english: Be beneficial to us, O Indu, when drunk into the heart, O Soma, gracious to the son as a father; wise, of wide fame, as a friend to a friend — O Soma, extend our life to live.

sanskrit: ime mā pītā yaśasas uruṣyavo rathaṁ na gāvaḥ sam anāha parvasū | te mā rakṣantu visrasaś caritrād uta mā srāmād yavayantv indavaḥ ||
english: These drops, when drunk, renowned, and widely protective, have bound the joints together as oxen a chariot; let them protect me from going astray, and let the Soma drops keep away fatigue.

sanskrit: agniṁ na mā mathitaṁ saṁ didīpaḥ pra cakṣaya kṛṇuhi vasya so naḥ | athā hi te mada ā soma manye revām̐ iva pra carā puṣṭim accha ||
english: Like Agni rubbed forth, kindle me up; make us see further; make us better; for then, O Soma, in your intoxication I think: go forward like a wealthy man toward abundance.

sanskrit: iṣireṇa te manasā sutasya bhakṣīmahi pitryas yeva rāyaḥ | soma rājan pra ṇa āyūṁṣi tārī r ahānīva sūryo vāsarāṇi ||
english: With eager mind may we partake of your pressed drink like the wealth of a father; O King Soma, extend our lives as the sun the days.

sanskrit: soma rājan mṛḻayā naḥ svasti tava smasi vratyās tasya viddhi | alarti dakṣa uta manyur indo mā no aryo anukāmam parā dāḥ ||
english: O King Soma, be gracious to us in wellbeing; we are your worshippers — know that; your discernment and wrath are roused, O Indu; do not hand us over to the will of the Ārya foe.

sanskrit: tvaṁ hi nas tanvaḥ soma gopā gātre-gātre niṣasatthā nṛcakṣāḥ | yat te vayam pra mināma vratāni sa no mṛḻa suṣakhā deva vasya ||
english: For you, O Soma, are the guardian of our body; you have sat in every limb, beholding men; when we have transgressed your ordinances, be gracious to us, O god, O best friend, for the sake of wealth.

sanskrit: ṛdūdareṇa sakhyā saceya yo mā na riṣyed dharyaśva pītaḥ | ayaṁ yaḥ somo ny adhāyy asme tasmā indram pratira m emy āyuḥ ||
english: May I accompany the friendship of the soft-bellied one, the one drunk, O Hariyaśva, that does not injure me; this Soma that has been set down in me — I go extending life to Indra for it.

sanskrit: apa tyā asthur anirā amīvā nir atrasan tamiṣīcīr abhai ṣuḥ | ā somo asmām̐ aruha d vihāyā aganma yatra pratirant a āyuḥ ||
english: Those feeble ailments have departed; the diseases have been driven out; the darkness has shuddered away; Soma has mounted up into us through the heavens; we have come where life is extended.

sanskrit: yo na indu ḥ pitaro hṛtsu pīto 'martyo martyām̐ āviveśa | tasmai somāya haviṣā vidhema mṛḻīke asya sumatau syāma ||
english: That Indu which was drunk by the Fathers in their hearts — the immortal entered into mortals; to that Soma let us offer with oblation; may we be in his gracious favour, in his good will.

sanskrit: tvaṁ soma pitṛbhiḥ saṁvidāno 'nu dyāvāpṛthivī ā tatantha | tasmai ta indo haviṣā vidhema vayaṁ syāma patayo rayīṇām ||
english: O Soma, communing with the Fathers, you have stretched yourself out along heaven and earth; to you, O Indu, let us offer with oblation; may we be lords of riches.

sanskrit: trātāro devā adhi vocatā no mā no nidrā īśata mota jalpiḥ | vayaṁ somasya viśvaha priyāsaḥ suvīrāso vidatham ā vadema ||
english: O gods who protect, proclaim to us: let not sleep overpower us, nor idle talk; may we, always beloved of Soma, with good heroes, speak in the assembly.

sanskrit: tvaṁ naḥ soma viśvato vayodhās tvaṁ svarvid ā viśā nṛcakṣāḥ | tvaṁ na inda ūtibhiḥ sajoṣāḥ pāhi paścātād uta vā purastāt ||
english: You, O Soma, give vigour from all sides; you who find the sun — enter into us, beholding men; O Indu, united with your aids, guard us from behind and also from in front.

sanskrit: abhi pra vaḥ surādhasam indram arca yathā vide | yo jaritṛbhyo maghavā purūvasuḥ sahasreṇeva śikṣati ||
english: Sing forward Indra of rich bounty as you know him — who as the bountiful one, abundant in wealth, provides for the singers as with a thousand.

sanskrit: śatānīkeva pra jigāti dhṛṣṇuyā hanti vṛtrāṇi dāśuṣe | girer iva pra rasā asya pinvire datrāṇi purubhojasaḥ ||
english: Like an army of hundreds he advances boldly; he slays the Vṛtras for the worshipper; like streams from a mountain his gifts of the many-nourishing one swell.

sanskrit: ā tvā sutāsa indavo madā ya indra girvaṇaḥ | āpo na vajrinn anv okyaṁ saraḥ pṛṇanti śūra rādhase ||
english: The pressed Soma drops, the exhilarations, O Indra, O lover of song — like waters, O vajra-bearer, they fill your own dwelling, your lake, O hero, for your bounty.

sanskrit: anehansaṁ prataraṇaṁ vivakṣaṇam adhvaḥ svādiṣṭham īm piba | ā yathā mandasānaḥ kirāsi naḥ pra kṣudreva tmanā dhṛṣat ||
english: Drink the sinless, surpassing, eloquent one, the sweetest drink; so that when exhilarated you scatter gifts upon us boldly by your own nature, like a small one.

sanskrit: ā naḥ stomam upa dravad dhiyāno aśvo na sotṛbhiḥ | yaṁ te svadhāvan svadayanti dhenava indra kaṇveṣu rātayaḥ ||
english: May our praise approach us, driven like a horse by the pressers; which the milch-cows make palatable for you, O self-ruling one, the gifts of Indra among the Kaṇvas.

sanskrit: ugraṁ na vīraṁ namasopa sedima vibhūtim akṣitāvasum | udrīva vajrinn avato na siñcate kṣarantīndra dhītayaḥ ||
english: We have approached with reverence the mighty hero, of widespread, inexhaustible wealth; O vajra-bearer, the devotions flow pouring like an udder at a well, O Indra.

sanskrit: yad dha nūnaṁ yad vā yajñe yad vā pṛthivyām adhi | ato no yajñam āśubhir mahemata ugra uGrebhir ā gahi ||
english: Whatever is now, whatever is at the sacrifice, whatever on the earth — from there, O mighty one, come with swift steeds, with great thoughts, with powerful ones, to our sacrifice.

sanskrit: ajirāso harayo ye ta āśavo vātā iva prasak ṣiṇaḥ | yebhir apatyam manuṣaḥ parīyase yebhir viśvaṁ svar dṛśe ||
english: Your agile, swift bay steeds that flow forward like winds — with which you go around the offspring of Manu, with which you make all the sun visible.

sanskrit: etāvatas ta īmaha indra sumnasya gomataḥ | yathā prāvo maghavan medhyātithiṁ yathā nīpātithiṁ dhane ||
english: For this much we implore you, O Indra, of favour rich in cattle — as, O Maghavan, you helped Medhyātithi, as you helped Nīpātithi in gaining wealth.

sanskrit: yathā kaṇve maghavan trasadasyavi yathā pakthe daśavraje | yathā gośarye asanor ṛjiśvanī ndra gomad dhiraṇyavat ||
english: As you, O Maghavan, helped Kaṇva against Trasadasyu, as you helped Paktha at Daśavraja, as you helped Ṛjiśvan of Gośarya — O Indra, with cattle and gold.

sanskrit: pra su śrutaṁ surādhasam arcā śakram abhiṣṭaye | yaḥ sunvate stuvate kāmyaṁ vasu sahasreṇeva maṁhate ||
english: Sing forth the famous, richly-bountiful Śakra for the sake of conquest; who lavishes desired wealth upon the Soma-presser and the praiser as with a thousand.

sanskrit: śatānīkā hetayo asya duṣṭarā indrasya samiṣo mahīḥ | girir na bhujmā maghava tsu pinvate yad īṁ sutā amandiṣuḥ ||
english: The missiles of this Indra are hundredfold, hard to withstand; his great impulsions — they swell like a bending mountain among the bountiful ones when the pressed drops have exhilarated him.

sanskrit: yad īṁ sutāsa indavo 'bhi priyam amandiṣuḥ | āpo na dhāyi savanam ma ā vaso dughā ivopa dāśuṣe ||
english: When the pressed Soma drops have exhilarated the dear one — O lord, the pressing is set as waters, like milch-cows to the worshipper.

sanskrit: anehansaṁ vo havamānam ūtaye madhvaḥ kṣaranti dhītayaḥ | ā tvā vaso havamānāsa indava upa streṣu dadhire ||
english: The sinless one, who is called upon for aid — the streams of the sweet drink flow as devotions; O lord, the Soma drops, calling upon you, have set themselves among the praises.

sanskrit: ā naḥ some svadhvara iyāno atyo na tośate | yaṁ te svadāvan svadanti gūrtayaḥ paure chandayase havam ||
english: When driving toward us, O Soma, at the good sacrifice, he is not slackened like a racing horse; the welcoming songs make palatable for you, O self-flavouring one, the invocation — you delight in it in the city.

sanskrit: pra vīram ugraṁ viviciṁ dhana spṛtaṁ vibhūtiṁ rādhaso mahaḥ | udrīva vajrinn avato vasutvanā sadā pīpetha dāśuṣe ||
english: Proclaim the mighty hero, the discriminating one, grasping wealth, the abundant one of great bounty; O vajra-bearer, you have ever nourished the worshipper with wealth like an udder at a well.

sanskrit: yad dha nūnam parāvati yad vā pṛthivyāṁ divi | yujāna indra haribhir mahemata ṛṣva ṛṣvebhir ā gahi ||
english: Whatever is now in the far distance, or on earth, or in the sky — come, O Indra, yoking the bay steeds, with great thoughts, O lofty one, with lofty ones.

sanskrit: rathirāso harayo ye te asridha ojo vātasya piprati | yebhir ni daśyum manuṣo nighoṣayo yebhiḥ svaḥ parīyase ||
english: Your bay steeds, the charioteers, who do not stumble, who carry the vigour of the wind — with which you surround the Dasyu for Manuṣa with a roar, with which you go around the sun.

sanskrit: etāvatas te vaso vidyāma śūra navyasaḥ | yathā prāva etaśaṁ kṛtvye dhane yathā vaśaṁ daśavraje ||
english: For this much, O lord, may we know you anew, O hero — as you helped Etaśa in the contested wealth, as you helped Vaśa at Daśavraja.

sanskrit: yathā kaṇve maghavan medhe adhvare dīrghanīthe damūnasi | yathā gośarye asiṣāso adrivo mayi gotraṁ hariśriyam ||
english: As you were present for Kaṇva at the sacrifice, the ceremony, at the long-guided rite, O home-friend; as you, O stone-wielder, shone forth at Gośarya — so be it for me, for the clan of golden glory.
